package.title: Open Weightは一枚岩ではない：distribution、local deployment、license境界
package.purpose: Kimi K3のexact licenseを中心に、Yi/BaichuanのApache-2.0系artifactをsupporting comparisonとして用い、weights公開、code、commercial use、attribution、Model-as-a-Service条件がartifactごとに異なることを整理する。
must_cover_requirements: Open SourceとOpen Weightを同義語として扱わず、weights、code、license、commercial conditionsを別々に記述する。
Kimi K3 Licenseのgrant、Model-as-a-Service条件、attribution/display条件をexact artifactに限定して要約する。
license記述を法的助言、infringement判断、third-party compliance判断へ拡張しない。
boundaries: The Kimi K3 License summary is artifact-specific and is not a legal opinion.
X license-friction discussion remains HOLD and cannot establish infringement, derivative provenance, applicable version, or legal interpretation.
This Evidence card summarizes the named 2026 Kimi K3 License only; it is not a legal opinion and does not establish infringement or compliance by third parties.
The Yi-1.5 repository alone cannot prove the absence of a later independent general Yi frontier endpoint; that negative conclusion remains a Discovery-level catalog observation.

Verify Yi-1.5 release, open/local deployment, fine-tuning integrations, licensing, and whether an official later general Yi endpoint exists within the as-of boundary.: The repository verifies Yi-1.5 release/deployment/fine-tuning/licensing; the absence of a later co-equal general endpoint is not established by this source alone and remains contextual.
The historical transition from the earlier independent Baichuan2 foundation-model line requires separate earlier evidence and is not established by the M3 model card alone.

Verify Baichuan M3 medical specialization, Qwen3-MoE ancestry, licensing/deployment, and the historical transition from the earlier independent Baichuan line.: The M3 model card verifies medical specialization, Qwen3-MoE ancestry/acknowledgement and Apache-2.0 licensing; the earlier-to-current historical transition is only partially represented by this source.

sources.title: Kimi K3 License
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The Kimi K3 License grants broad use, copying, modification, distribution, sublicensing, selling, deployment and fine-tuning rights subject to stated conditions.

The license includes a separate-agreement condition for a defined Model-as-a-Service business above USD 20 million aggregate revenue over any consecutive 12 months and an attribution/display condition for covered large commercial products/services, with specified exclusions.

limitations.text: This Evidence card summarizes the named 2026 Kimi K3 License only; it is not a legal opinion and does not establish infringement or compliance by third parties.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.target: Verify the exact Kimi K3 license grant, Model-as-a-Service condition, revenue/MAU attribution thresholds, exclusions, and subject/version applicability from the license text.
targets.finding: The exact license text establishes the broad grant, the stated Model-as-a-Service revenue condition, the 100M-MAU/USD-20M-monthly-revenue display condition, exclusions, and applicability to the covered Kimi K3 software/weights.
